The situation

GRAIL came to us with no outbound running. No sending infrastructure, no lists, no tested copy. Everything was built from zero.

Why we're showing a 3-week result

Most case studies show a best month after a year of tuning. This one shows the start. If you're deciding whether to work with us, the first three weeks are what you'll actually experience.

What we did

1. We built and warmed the infrastructure for them. Domains, mailboxes and warm-up were set up and managed on GRAIL's behalf. They didn't touch a single DNS record.

2. We built a list around their real buyer. Targeting was modelled on the researchers already using GRAIL, then enriched and verified so every email reached an active researcher in a relevant field.

3. We let the product sell itself. Researchers are skeptical of AI claims. So the email leads with proof they respect, the institutions whose researchers already use it, and removes the cost of trying: $100 in credits to test it on their own work.

4. We launched small and scaled on proof. Sending started conservatively and increased only as inbox placement held, reaching 45,000 emails by day 21.
